_doc: BUG-3195: shared by internal/models/progress_abandoned_parity_test.go and web/src/lib/collections/childProgress.parity.test.ts. KEEP-IN-SYNC: each case is one collection (schema + settings as STORED JSON strings) and its children's field objects; `go` and `web` give each child's state (out = abandoned, left out of done AND total; done; open) and the totals. They are equal except where a case documents a divergence in `why`. Add a case here, not to one language's test.

cases.name: declared abandoned_options
cases.why: the field's own list decides: cancelled is out, done counts

cases.name: undeclared, NegativeTerminals fallback
cases.why: no abandoned_options: terminal values in the negative list are out, others are delivered

cases.name: a declared list replaces the fallback
cases.why: declaring only `dropped` makes cancelled a delivered terminal

cases.name: board_group_by done field
cases.why: the done field is `resolution`; a terminal `status` does not count

cases.name: every child abandoned is 0/0
cases.why: nothing counted; renders as no progress

cases.name: corrupt schema: a mistyped member the resolvers do not read
cases.why: DOCUMENTED DIVERGENCE (BUG-3195 codex round 4). `options: 7` fails Go's typed unmarshal of the whole schema, so Go falls back to status + the default terminal list, where `shipped` is not terminal (open). The web validates only the members it reads, keeps the field, and applies the declared list (out). The server's /progress is the authority for a parent's numbers; this is the per-row client count on a corrupt schema.
